_note: Machine-readable gate ledger. A gate is PASS only with implementation, build, real execution, acceptance thresholds and reproducible evidence all green. BLOCKED gates are never simulated or silently marked PASS.

G04.title: Concurrent-safe residency (generation leases, in-flight pinning, fence-safe eviction, tick-gated prefetch)
G04.root_cause_of_reopen: std::sort comparator in EvictLeastRecentlyUsed read the live atomic lastUseSequence and the stateful GhostCache score from inside the comparator, so the relation was not a strict weak ordering (comp(a,b) and comp(b,a) could both be true). std::sort is undefined for a non-conforming comparator; std::_Insertion_sort_unchecked walked *--_Prev off the front of the candidate vector -> ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ 8 bytes before the buffer. Fixed by snapshotting each candidate's score once under tensorsMutex_ and sorting immutable snapshot values with a stable identity tie-break.
also_fixed: TOCTOU in all six AcquireTensor hand-out sites: state read then pointers captured and lease taken unlocked; now unified in TakeLeaseAtomic which re-validates state and pins the mapping in the same critical section as the pointer capture
Eviction now performs transition + free + generation advance inside one tensorsMutex_ critical section and re-validates the pin immediately before freeing
Stale-lease releases refused without decrementing the live mapping's pin count
Generation advance saturates at UINT32_MAX, never wrapping to a revalidatable value
Implemented the missing VwaResolveBlocks definition (declared in VwaRangeAbi.hpp and called from ExecuteNvmeToRam but defined nowhere -> LNK2019)
Eviction-deferred livelock guard: pinned-only working set fails closed instead of looping or freeing a live mapping (RAWRXD_EVICT_LIVELOCK_001)
RAWRXD_TICKLATCH_001 prefetch warm-up latch wired to ExecuteNvmeToRam completion
known_limitations: VwaResolveBlocks saturation at UINT32_MAX is guaranteed by the saturating CAS advance and verified by inspection; reaching the ceiling needs ~4.29e9 retire/re-map cycles and is not a runnable assertion. The test proves monotonic advance and that 0 is never returned to.

Legacy AcquireForCpu / BindForGpuCompute still return raw pointers without a generation lease. They are outside the Cyclone acquire/release contract this gate certifies but carry the same latent race and should be migrated to TakeLeaseAtomic.

G05.title: Q2_K/Q3_K/Q5_K native kernels with numerical parity
root_causes_fixed: block_q2_K/block_q3_K/block_q5_K field order in QuantKernelRegistry.hpp did not match ggml-common.h (q2_K/q3_K/q5_K put the fp16 super-scales at the END of the block). Now asserted by static_assert on size and offsetof per field.
vec_dot_q2_K_q8_K_single applied one scale byte to all 32 elements of a group; ggml uses scales[8n+2j] for the first 16 and scales[8n+2j+1] for the second 16.
vec_dot_q2_K_q8_K_single paired the min term with bsums[2n + j/2] (4 of 8 relevant sums, replicated); ggml uses all 16 high nibbles paired 1:1 with bsums[0..15].

vec_dot_q3_K_q8_K_single advanced q8 by 128 per super-block instead of 32 per group, and read hmask[32*n + l] past the 32-byte hmask; ggml reuses the same 32 hmask bytes with the mask bit continuing to shift.
vec_dot_q5_K_q8_K_single had a stack buffer overrun (a[32*h+32+l] past int8_t a[256]) and indexed qs/qh independently where ggml walks them in lockstep.
G05.parity_criterion: Order-independent: |Deep2 - exact_double| <= |ggml_f32 - exact_double| + slack. ggml_f32 is the verbatim transcription of ggml_vec_dot_q*_K_q8_K_generic, so Deep2 must be at least as accurate as ggml's own float32 accumulation. A mathematical error cannot pass this bound.

acceptance.q2k_dequant_walk: PASS (800 blocks x 256 weights = 204800 weights, exact)
